Discrepancies in Dapagliflozin Response in Terms of Glycemic Control and Body Weight Reduction. Dapagliflozin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor, reduces hyperglycemia and obesity by inhibiting renal glucose reabsorption. This post hoc study evaluated clinical factors influencing patient response to dapagliflozin.
